rationale: Create one canonical IENTC Telecomunicaciones record and reject the census's false IEnova energy-company expansion. Primary manager, company, SEC and regulator sources identify IENTC, S. de R.L. de C.V. as an active Mexican fiber operator. CIM-managed funds invested in the first quarter of 2022, retain 45% aggregate equity and board representation, and remained invested after the separate IENTC 2 debt was repaid in 2025. IENTC 1 and IENTC 2 are investment/security vehicles, not separate operating PortCos. No CIM equity exit or signed pending ownership transaction was found through August 19, 2026.

afterImage.description: IENTC Telecomunicaciones is a Mexican telecommunications operator that owns and operates fiber infrastructure serving carrier, corporate and residential customers. The company provides dedicated internet access, data transport, dark fiber, fiber-to-the-home and telephony services and reports approximately 37,500 kilometres of fiber across Mexico. Its legal name is IENTC, S. de R.L. de C.V., and it is headquartered in Santiago de Querétaro. CIM-managed funds invested in the first quarter of 2022 and retain 45% aggregate equity with board representation; CIM Real Assets & Credit Fund separately reported a 21.3% interest in IENTC 1, LLC. IENTC 2 debt was repaid in full during fiscal 2025, but the equity investment remained active. The exact legal chain between IENTC 1 and the Mexican operating company, the second CIM vehicle and the non-CIM shareholder identities are not publicly disclosed. IENTC is unrelated to the separate Sempra company Infraestructura Energética Nova. No CIM equity exit or signed pending ownership transaction was identified through August 19, 2026.
